animations.carried: sneaky walk while carried: tiptoes in the air and glances side to side, in on the heist, never struggling
animations.denIdle: happy idle in the den: its eye looks around slowly, then stares straight at the camera
animations.stolen: gotcha pose when stolen: a quick enigmatic gotcha, in on the joke, never sad or scared

look: a creature whose entire body is a window into a deep purple starry galaxy with nebula clouds: one smooth rounded teardrop shape for head and body, two tall pointed ears trailing wisps of smoke, no whiskers, no mouth, one single glowing crescent-moon eye in the center of its face and no other eyes, a long curling tail, and a thin glowing ring of light orbiting it with tiny stars
name: The Midnight Mew
pose: floating above the ground, its lower body dissolving into drifting stardust instead of legs
